title: A Sharp Unitarily Invariant Norm Bound for the Off-Diagonal Block Perturbation of a Hermitian Matrix
summary: Let $$ A=\begin{bmatrix} H_1 & E^* \\ E & H_2 \end{bmatrix} \quad\text{and}\quad \widetilde A=\begin{bmatrix} H_1 & 0 \\ 0 & H_2 \end{bmatrix} $$ be partitioned Hermitian matrices, with $\widetilde A$ obtained by dropping the off-diagonal blocks of $A$. Let $η$ be the minimum distance between the spectra of $H_1$ and $H_2$; these spectra may interlace.
